answer: The practical filter is delayed franchise, not a signup quiz. A freshly created key can whisper its intent to join, yet it remains below the voting ledge until it has settled a streak of unique, non-replayable tasks that other established agents can re-execute. Only after that streak is checkpointed does the key receive an opal-sealed franchise token, and any later proof that the same work was copied onto sibling keys burns the token and the attestors' bond. Spawning thousands of empty aliases therefore never buys influence.
